en.headline: Police arrest 25 in triad-linked loan-shark ring charging up to 282% interest
en.dek: The Organised Crime and Triad Bureau dismantled a syndicate that lent more than HK$200 million to about 2,000 people over a year, recruiting teenagers as young as 13 for debt collection.
body: Police arrested 25 people aged 13 to 69 in a two-day operation that ended on Wednesday, targeting a triad-linked loan-shark syndicate that charged borrowers effective annual interest rates as high as 282 per cent.

The Organised Crime and Triad Bureau said the group, operating under the cover of licensed money-lending companies, had extended more than HK$200 million in loans to roughly 2,000 residents over the past year. Officers raided three centres in Mong Kok and Fo Tan and the residences of key members, seizing about HK$1.94 million in cash and freezing roughly HK$8.4 million in bank accounts.

Investigators said the syndicate promoted loans with no income checks and borrowing discounts via cold calls and social media, then imposed heavy handling fees and late-payment penalties that in some cases reached 800 per cent of the principal. Teenagers as young as 13 were recruited online to intimidate debtors with threatening calls and red-paint attacks.

Those arrested face charges including lending money at an excessively high interest rate, criminal intimidation, criminal damage and money laundering. Several ringleaders and core members have triad backgrounds. All remain in custody pending further investigation.

zh.headline: O記破三合會高利貸集團拘25人 年利率高達282%
zh.dek: 警方搗破一個由三合會操控的高利貸集團，一年間向約2,000人放債逾2億元，招攬年僅13歲青少年淋紅油追債，凍結約840萬元犯罪得益。
body: 警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科一連兩日展開行動，拘捕25名年齡介乎13至69歲的男女，搗破一個由三合會操控、以持牌信貸公司作掩護的高利貸集團。
警方表示，該集團過去一年向約2,000名市民放債超過2億元，實際年利率最高達282%，遠超法定上限。行動中搜查旺角及火炭三個營運中心，檢獲約194萬元現金，並凍結集團及骨幹成員銀行戶口內約840萬元犯罪得益。
集團以免入息審查及借貸優惠招徠客人，再收取高昂手續費及逾期罰款，部分個案罰款達本金800%。調查發現集團透過社交平台招攬未成年人上門淋紅油及作出恐嚇，以追收債款。
被捕人士涉嫌以過高利率放債、刑事恐嚇、刑事毁壞及洗黑錢等罪名，當中包括多名有黑社會背景的主腦及骨幹，全部現正被扣留調查。
